'''Havoc Squad's BT-7 ''Thunderclap''''' was a [[BT-7 Thunderclap|BT-7 ''Thunderclap'']] used by the [[Havoc Squad]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. It was provided to [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Havoc Squad Lieutenant]] and [[Aric Jorgan]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza]] as the means to track down [[Harron Tavus]] and his traitor followers. Following the conslusion of the [[SpecForce Incident]], Havoc continued to use the ship in preparation for the assault on the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|''Gauntlet'' superweapon]], culminating in the [[Battle of the Gauntlet]]. The ship was used by Havoc Squad throughout the campaign against General [[Arkos Rakton]].<ref name="TOR" />
